## Goal

Make one projection decide what a given viewer may see at a given time, and use it for every public output, so the record is complete and nothing is disclosed early.

## Context

Public outputs reach their data by several paths today: the detail page and the home page share one control, while the history list, the archive, page metadata and the machine-readable outputs do not. The public history also omits one terminal state, so the record is not complete even though the promise is that it is. Details are in the owner's private tracker.

## Scope

- One projection, by viewer and point in time, used by the detail page, the history list, the archive, page titles and metadata, the sitemap and the machine-readable outputs.
- Show every published, closed analysis, keeping the financial rule for cancelled ones.
- Exclude fixture and test records from the projection and from every figure, list and export derived from it. Such records are identifiable by the marker the fixture tooling sets (SC-022, #27); this package owns keeping them out of everything public. This is a public-launch blocker.
- Separate a safe public name and identifier from text that belongs to the paid product.
- A documented rule for an analysis that is settled before its public delay has elapsed.
- `docs/SECURITY.md` and `docs/SPEC.md` updated.

## Out of scope

- Rendering the paid view for a subscriber (SC-008).
- Redesigning these pages (SC-007).
- Changing settlement logic (SC-023).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] One projection is the only source for every listed output, shown by a search in the PR.
- [ ] Tests cover each output for an anonymous viewer at several points in time, including page HTML, the streamed payload, metadata and the machine-readable outputs.
- [ ] Counts and figures agree between the detail page, the history list and the export.
- [ ] Every published closed analysis appears in the public history.
- [ ] **Binding, public-launch blocker:** no record created by the fixture or seed tooling appears in any public output: pages (HTML and streamed payload), history list, archive, titles and metadata, sitemap, machine-readable outputs, every statistic and aggregate (counts, success rate, return, profit, streaks, drawdown, homepage figures) and every export. Shown against a database that holds fixture and real records side by side, with the real output pasted.
- [ ] The exclusion is made once, in the projection. Any public or statistics query that reads analyses outside it is listed in the PR and brought under it, and a search shows none left.
- [ ] Regression tests (see below) fail when the exclusion is removed, shown once in the PR.
- [ ] Before launch, a count of fixture-marked records in the production database is recorded on this issue and is zero.
- [ ] Independent review approves.

## Required tests

- Unit tests for the projection.
- Route-level tests per output.
- Regression tests with fixture records in every state (open, settled as win, loss and void, cancelled, scheduled), shaped exactly like real records: each public output and each aggregate must show real-only content and totals. An inventory test fails when a public output is added that does not go through the projection.
- All standard checks.

## Dependencies

- SC-022
- SC-023
